propositions: Canonical bridge preview/sync routes must emit only exit codes 0 (success/benign), 1 (operational failure), and 2 (invalid invocation) without emitting legacy codes 3/4/75
Legacy reconcile CLI and direct-engine adapter routes must retain and emit historical exit codes 3 (live pass), 4 (phase gate), and 75 (reschedule) with original messages and defaults
One typed disposition representation must be consumed by both canonical and legacy exit adapters, with the adapter choosing which numeric translation to emit based on route type
Production workflows and consumers must use only canonical 0/1/2 codes with no whitelist of legacy 3/4/75 values, while legacy environments remain backwards compatible
Paused state must skip commit-and-push in both canonical and legacy routes, and all state markers must remain stable across the migration
